records.claim_text: An edition date, the dates or versions of evidence assessed, and the period or date of a service interaction describe different objects. The ISG annual-access offer and dated Global Payroll2025 assessment illustrate this separation. For a Table edition-context briefing, identify which edition/evidence period is being discussed; a later briefing date does not by itself make the underlying evidence current.
records.locator: ISG227 parsed lines119–126; ISG229 heading lines113–114 and Products Evaluated dates/versions at209–237; analyst application to TP01–TP03
records.limitations: No universal expiry date, mandatory refresh cadence, annual JGA subscription, product suitability today or extra briefing fee is inferred. Actual relevant source/case periods still govern applicability. This does not require a separate dated field for every sentence.

records.claim_text: ONS distinguishes correction of a published mistake from revision using improved methods or information unavailable at first publication. This is a useful change-reason distinction for a research edition, without importing ONS procedures into the JGA project.
records.locator: ONS policy sections1,3 and4; retained numbered text lines76–100
records.limitations: ONS statistics-policy analogy only, not a JGA legal standard, payroll finding or statement that a current error exists. No ONS timetable, exceptions, index methods or thresholds adopted.

records.claim_text: For the proposed Table offers, classify a requested change by reason and effect before describing it as an update or extra service: fix an error or scope defect under the current agreement, assess genuinely later evidence/method work separately, and keep a new user task distinct from both. Preserve the edition/change history and what users received. Genuine expanded work can be scoped only through the actual agreement; no change is automatically chargeable.
records.locator: Analytical application of ONS sections1,3–4; current working agreement section6 defect-remedy and written-change clauses as internal design constraint
records.limitations: No amendment of current contract, unilateral fee, arbitrary support period, future SLA, retrospective rights change or adoption of an ONS release regime. Current correction obligations remain; the analysis does not classify an actual customer request or add work to the project.
